Good afternoon,

We sincerely apologize for the confusion and inconvenience caused. Unfortunately, as the team is unable to arrive promptly at 11:30 AM as scheduled, the appointment has been cancelled.

The team has requested to reschedule the visit for tomorrow, preferably between 5:00 PM and 6:00 PM. We completely understand that arranging access can be inconvenient, and we truly appreciate your patience and kind cooperation.

Please let us know if tomorrow between 5:00 PM and 6:00 PM would be convenient for you.

Once again, we sincerely apologize for the change and any inconvenience this may have caused, and we truly appreciate your understanding.
